## Figure legend

**Supplementary Figure 22.** Cell viability quantification of the samples in Figure 6A by PI/SYTO9
staining. A–D) Exponential cells (untreated, rich media) of WT (SC5314) and *nrg1*Δ, *ndt80*Δ and
*stp4*Δ. E–H) Quiescent cells (Day 3, rich media) of the same strains. Each row shows the PI and
SYTO9 distribution functions of single cells (one line per biological replicate, n = 3) and the
gated PI/SYTO9 2D quantification of each replicate separately (Replicate 1–3, framed in the
replicate colour). Gate labels give the percentage of single cells of that replicate in the
Live_cells and Dead_cells gates. Viability (Live / (Live + Dead)) of that replicate is shown in the
top-left corner. The per-replicate plots show the variation between replicates and support the
sample selection.

(Full legend text is in the folder README.)

## Input data

The 24 FCS files are the ones behind Figure 6A. They come from two experiments:

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `data/Figure_6A_samples.csv` | 24 samples: state, knockout, replicate, FCS file, SYTO9 channel, gating template and the saved Live/Dead counts |
| `data/cytek_gating_OzanImir_20260809_v1.csv` | Gating template, exponential samples (SYTO9 = B7-A) |
| `data/cytek_gating_OzanImir_20260401_v1.csv` | Gating template, quiescent samples (SYTO9 = B3-A) |

* Exponential: untreated rich-media samples of `Knockout_Quiescence_Viability_4_ValidationExtended/Proliferative`
  (6HC group; NRG1 uses its DR-group untreated samples, as in Figure 6A).
* Quiescent: Day 3 samples of `Knockout_Quiescence_Viability_3_Validation`.

The raw FCS files are not distributed. They are read from `params$fcs_root`. If that folder is
missing, the gating and plotting chunks are skipped.

```{r samples}
samples <- read.csv(data_path("Figure_6A_samples.csv"))
samples[, c("state", "knockout", "replicate", "syto9_channel", "Live_cells", "Dead_cells")]
```

## FCS reading and gating

flowCore, flowWorkspace and CytoExploreR are not needed. The FCS files are read directly, and the
saved CytoExploreR gating templates are applied to them.

* `cyto_transformer_arcsinh()` produced the flowJo arcsinh transform with its defaults
  (T = 262144, M = 4.5, A = 0). The `cofactor` argument in the original notebooks had no effect.
  Gate coordinates are in that transformed space.
* The gating is Cells (FSC-A/SSC-A) > Single_cells (SSC-A/SSC-H) > Live_cells and Dead_cells
  (YG4-A = PI vs SYTO9).
* The next chunk checks the Live/Dead counts against the saved per-sample tables.

```{r functions}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# Minimal FCS 3.x reader (float32 list-mode data, as written by the Cytek Aurora)
read_fcs <- function(path) {
  con <- file(path, "rb"); on.exit(close(con))
  hdr <- readChar(con, 58, useBytes = TRUE)
  ts <- as.integer(substr(hdr, 11, 18)); te <- as.integer(substr(hdr, 19, 26))
  seek(con, ts); txt <- readChar(con, te - ts + 1, useBytes = TRUE)
  d <- substr(txt, 1, 1); parts <- strsplit(substring(txt, 2), d, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  kw <- setNames(parts[seq(2, length(parts), 2)], toupper(parts[seq(1, length(parts), 2)]))
  stopifnot(kw[["$DATATYPE"]] == "F")
  npar <- as.integer(kw[["$PAR"]]); ntot <- as.integer(kw[["$TOT"]])
  endian <- if (kw[["$BYTEORD"]] == "1,2,3,4") "little" else "big"
  seek(con, as.numeric(trimws(kw[["$BEGINDATA"]])))
  m <- matrix(readBin(con, "numeric", n = npar * ntot, size = 4, endian = endian), ncol = npar, byrow = TRUE)
  colnames(m) <- vapply(seq_len(npar), function(i) kw[[paste0("$P", i, "N")]], "")
  m
}

# flowJo arcsinh as used by CytoExploreR (T = 262144, M = 4.5, A = 0)
fasinh <- function(x, t = 262144, m = 4.5) asinh(x * sinh(m * log(10)) / t) / (m * log(10))

# Polygon gates from a CytoExploreR gatingTemplate
parse_template <- function(csv) {
  gt <- read.csv(csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(gt)), function(i) {
    nums <- as.numeric(strsplit(sub(".*boundaries = structure\\(c\\(([^)]*)\\).*", "\\1",
                                    gt$gating_args[i]), ",")[[1]])
    dims <- strsplit(gt$dims[i], ",")[[1]]
    list(parent = gt$parent[i], dims = dims, poly = matrix(nums, ncol = 2, dimnames = list(NULL, dims)))
  }), gt$alias)
}

apply_gates <- function(tm, gates) {
  keep <- list(root = rep(TRUE, nrow(tm)))
  for (g in names(gates)) {
    G <- gates[[g]]
    inside <- sp::point.in.polygon(tm[, G$dims[1]], tm[, G$dims[2]], G$poly[, 1], G$poly[, 2]) > 0
    keep[[g]] <- keep[[G$parent]] & inside
  }
  keep
}
```

```{r gating, eval = fcs_available}
templates <- lapply(setNames(nm = unique(samples$gating_template)), function(f) parse_template(data_path(f)))

events <- vector("list", nrow(samples))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(samples))) {
  s <- samples[i, ]
  raw <- read_fcs(file.path(params$fcs_root, s$fcs_subdir, s$fcs_file))
  tm <- raw
  for (ch in c("FSC-A", "FSC-H", "SSC-A", "SSC-H", "YG4-A", s$syto9_channel)) tm[, ch] <- fasinh(raw[, ch])
  k <- apply_gates(tm, templates[[s$gating_template]])
  sc <- k$Single_cells
  events[[i]] <- tibble(state = s$state, knockout = s$knockout, replicate = s$replicate,
                        PI = raw[sc, "YG4-A"], SYTO9 = raw[sc, s$syto9_channel],
                        PI_t = tm[sc, "YG4-A"], SYTO9_t = tm[sc, s$syto9_channel],
                        gate = case_when(k$Live_cells[sc] ~ "Live_cells", k$Dead_cells[sc] ~ "Dead_cells",
                                         TRUE ~ "ungated"))
  samples$Live_recomputed[i] <- sum(k$Live_cells)
  samples$Dead_recomputed[i] <- sum(k$Dead_cells)
  samples$Single_cells[i] <- sum(sc)
}
events <- bind_rows(events)

# The gating must reproduce the saved counts behind Figure 6A exactly
stopifnot(all(samples$Live_recomputed == samples$Live_cells), all(samples$Dead_recomputed == samples$Dead_cells))
samples %>% mutate(viability = Live_cells / (Live_cells + Dead_cells)) %>%
  select(state, knockout, replicate, Single_cells, Live_cells, Dead_cells, viability)
```

## Figure

Each row shows the PI and SYTO9 distribution functions (one line per replicate) followed by one
PI/SYTO9 2D plot per biological replicate (Replicate 1–3). The 2D plots are framed in the
replicate colour used in the histograms. Gate labels and viability are those of that replicate.

```{r figure, eval = fcs_available, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 30}
theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 12))
strains <- c("WT", "NRG1", "NDT80", "STP4")
rep_cols <- c(`1` = "#000000", `2` = "#0072B2", `3` = "#D55E00")
dens_cols <- c("#00007F", "blue", "#007FFF", "cyan", "#7FFF7F", "yellow", "#FF7F00", "red", "#7F0000")

# Per-replicate gate percentages (of single cells) and viability (Live / (Live + Dead))
gate_pct <- events %>% count(state, knockout, replicate, gate) %>%
  group_by(state, knockout, replicate) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()
viab <- samples %>% mutate(v = 100 * Live_cells / (Live_cells + Dead_cells)) %>%
  select(state, knockout, replicate, v)

hist_panel <- function(df, var, xlabel) {
  df <- df[df[[var]] > 0 & is.finite(df[[var]]), ]
  ggplot(df, aes(.data[[var]], colour = factor(replicate))) +
    geom_freqpoly(bins = 200, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(1, 1e6), breaks = 10^c(1, 3, 5), labels = c("10", "1000", "100000")) +
    annotation_logticks(sides = "b", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rep_cols, name = "Replicate") +
    labs(x = xlabel, y = "Count") +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 10))
}

# Axis breaks for the transformed scale, labelled in raw units
br_raw <- c(-1e2, 0, 1e2, 1e3, 1e4, 1e5)
br_lab <- c(expression(-10^2), "0", expression(10^2), expression(10^3), expression(10^4), expression(10^5))
lims <- c(fasinh(-400), 1)

# One 2D plot for one replicate; density is computed within that replicate
scatter_panel <- function(df, gates, st, ko, r) {
  df <- df[df$replicate == r, ]
  bx <- cut(df$PI_t, 256); by <- cut(df$SYTO9_t, 256)
  df$dens <- ave(rep(1, nrow(df)), bx, by, FUN = length)
  df <- df[order(df$dens), ]
  polys <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Live_cells", "Dead_cells"), function(g)
    tibble(gate = g, x = gates[[g]]$poly[, 1], y = gates[[g]]$poly[, 2])))
  labs_df <- polys %>% group_by(gate) %>% summarise(x = mean(range(x)), y = mean(range(y))) %>%
    left_join(filter(gate_pct, state == st, knockout == ko, replicate == r) %>% select(gate, pct), by = "gate") %>%
    mutate(label = sprintf("%s\n%.2f %%", gate, coalesce(pct, 0)))
  v <- viab$v[viab$state == st & viab$knockout == ko & viab$replicate == r]
  ggplot(df, aes(PI_t, SYTO9_t)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = dens), size = 0.06, shape = 16) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = dens_cols, trans = "log10", guide = "none") +
    geom_polygon(data = polys, aes(x, y, group = gate), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 fill = NA, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_label(data = labs_df, aes(x, y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3,
               fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, fill = alpha("white", 0.6), label.size = 0,
               label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines")) +
    annotate("label", x = lims[1] + 0.015, y = lims[2] - 0.015, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.4,
             label = sprintf("viability %.1f %%", v), fill = alpha("white", 0.8), label.size = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = fasinh(br_raw), labels = br_lab) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = fasinh(br_raw), labels = br_lab) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = lims, ylim = lims, expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "PI", y = "SYTO9") +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = rep_cols[[as.character(r)]], fill = NA, linewidth = 1.6),
          axis.line = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size = 9))
}

strain_lab <- function(ko) if (ko == "WT") "WT (SC5314)" else bquote(italic(.(tolower(ko))) * Delta)
widths <- c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1)
rows <- list(); k <- 0
for (st in c("Exponential", "Quiescent")) {
  tmpl <- templates[[unique(samples$gating_template[samples$state == st])]]
  for (ko in strains) {
    k <- k + 1
    df <- filter(events, state == st, knockout == ko)
    row <- plot_grid(plotlist = c(list(hist_panel(df, "PI", "PI"), hist_panel(df, "SYTO9", "SYTO9")),
                                  lapply(1:3, function(r) scatter_panel(df, tmpl, st, ko, r))),
                     nrow = 1, rel_widths = widths, align = "h", axis = "tb")
    title <- ggdraw() + draw_label(strain_lab(ko), x = 0.025, hjust = 0, size = 15, fontface = "bold")
    rows[[k]] <- plot_grid(title, row, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.12, 1),
                           labels = LETTERS[k], label_size = 22, label_x = 0, hjust = 0)
  }
}

section <- function(txt) ggdraw() + draw_label(txt, x = 0, hjust = 0, size = 17, fontface = "bold")
# Column headers: histogram columns, then one header per replicate in its histogram colour
col_header <- function() {
  hdr <- function(txt, col = "black") ggdraw() + draw_label(txt, size = 15, fontface = "bold", colour = col)
  plot_grid(plotlist = c(list(hdr("PI distribution"), hdr("SYTO9 distribution")),
                         lapply(1:3, function(r) hdr(paste("Replicate", r), rep_cols[[r]]))),
            nrow = 1, rel_widths = widths)
}
legend <- get_legend(hist_panel(filter(events, knockout == "WT"), "PI", "PI") +
                       theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
                             legend.text = element_text(size = 13), legend.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
                       guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2))))
fig <- plot_grid(legend,
                 section("Exponential (untreated, rich media)"), col_header(), plot_grid(plotlist = rows[1:4], ncol = 1),
                 section("Quiescent (Day 3, rich media)"), col_header(), plot_grid(plotlist = rows[5:8], ncol = 1),
                 ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.3, 0.35, 0.3, 4 * 3.6, 0.35, 0.3, 4 * 3.6))
fig
ggsave(out_path("Supplementary_Figure_22.png"), fig, width = 18, height = 30, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
write.csv(samples %>% mutate(viability = Live_cells / (Live_cells + Dead_cells)) %>%
            select(state, knockout, replicate, fcs_file, Single_cells, Live_cells, Dead_cells, viability),
          out_path("Supplementary_Figure_22_gate_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gate_pct %>% select(-n) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = gate, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0) %>%
            left_join(viab, by = c("state", "knockout", "replicate")) %>% rename(viability_pct = v),
          out_path("Supplementary_Figure_22_replicate_gate_percentages.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
